content_sections.heading: APPSC Welfare Officers Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 114 provisional vacancies are on offer, as detailed below. The Commission has noted in both notifications that the number of vacancies is subject to variation upon confirmation from the concerned department. Within Notification No. 25/2026, Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II posts alone total 73 (21 + 23 + 29), and Notification No. 26/2026 accounts for the remaining 17 posts (11 + 6). Both notifications are for General Recruitment.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Welfare Officers Selection Process
content_sections.text: As stated in both notifications, selection will be through a single-level examination only - no Screening Test will be conducted, irrespective of the number of applications received. The examination will be conducted in online Computer-Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) mode. Where the single-level examination is held in multiple sessions, the Commission will apply a normalisation process to the marks, wherever considered necessary and applicable, as per a methodology to be notified by the Commission in due course. As per Annexure-III of G.O.Ms.No.141, Finance (HR-I Plg. & Policy) Dept., dated 01/08/2016, read with G.O.Ms.No.100, GA (Ser-A) Department, dated 30/09/2022: As per Annexure-V of G.O.Ms.No.201, Finance (HR-I Plg. & Policy) Dept., dated 21/12/2017: For both examinations, as per G.O.Ms. No.235, Finance (HR-I, Plg & Policy) Dept., dated 06/12/2016, each wrong answer in the objective-type papers will be penalised with 1/3rd of the marks prescribed for that question. The detailed subject-wise syllabus for each post's examination is annexed to its respective notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is APPSC Welfare Officers Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a set of 2 Brief Notifications (Nos. 25/2026 and 26/2026), both dated 15 September 2026, issued by the Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission for direct recruitment to 114 posts of Assistant Social Welfare Officer, Assistant Tribal Welfare Officer, and Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in APPSC Welfare Officers Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 114 provisional vacancies: 11 Assistant Social Welfare Officer, 6 Assistant Tribal Welfare Officer, and 73 Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (21 in Social Welfare, 23 in Tribal Welfare, and 29 in Backward Classes Welfare Subordinate Service).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for APPSC Welfare Officers Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application last date is 29 October 2026, up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for APPSC Welfare Officers posts?
faq.answer: Assistant Social Welfare Officer and Assistant Tribal Welfare Officer require a Bachelor's Degree from a recognised university or equivalent. The qualification for Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II is not yet specified and will appear in the Detailed Notification.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply online for APPSC Welfare Officers Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only at psc.ap.gov.in between 9 October 2026 and 29 October 2026, as described in the How to Apply section above.

faq.question: Q6. What is the APPSC Welfare Officers selection process?
faq.answer: Selection for both notifications is through a single-level online (CBRT) examination only, with no separate Screening Test; marks may be normalised if the exam is held in multiple sessions. Assistant Social/Tribal Welfare Officer has a 3-paper, 450-mark exam, while Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II has a 2-paper, 300-mark exam, as detailed in the Selection Process section above.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for APPSC Welfare Officers posts?
faq.answer: Assistant Social Welfare Officer and Assistant Tribal Welfare Officer carry a pay scale of ₹48,440–₹1,37,220, while Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II carries a pay scale of ₹37,640–₹1,15,500.
